notes: All rows are from the 'Personnel by region' table (FTE, 31.12.25) in UBS Group's Annual Report 2025 / Form 20-F. The table nests: 'of which: US' sits inside Americas; 'of which: UK', 'rest of Europe (excluding Switzerland)' and 'Middle East and Africa' sit inside EMEA (excluding Switzerland). Countries rows (CH, US, UK) therefore overlap the region rows; do not add them together. Rest of Europe and Middle East and Africa are sub-regions of EMEA. Total 103,177 FTE (108,648 a year earlier). The filing does not list the countries in each region, so countries is null on every region. No U.S. state breakdown exists. UBS does not publish a group country-by-country tax report in the annual report; none used.
